oliver: Heads-up — trying a small publish tonight in the 18:00-20:00 PT window: Py SDK 1.5.0 and TS SDK 2.0.0. Canary start 5%.
oliver: TS moves to async-first; Py will soft-deprecate the sync client (keep shim for 2 minors with warnings). Need pinback plan for Dedicated and release notes owner. @sam @tia ack pls.
sam: Ack. I'll kick the deploy-bot. Packages: py wheel -> 1.5.0; npm @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 with dist-tag 'canary'.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job queued (2788881234-canary): py:1.5.0@5%, ts:2.0.0@5%. ETA +3m.
tia: Staging smoke for TS failing on sync wrapper: "TypeError: shim.request is not a function". Patch in PR needs quick review.
sam: Hold TS canary. Rolling back TS canary only. deploy-bot, run: rollback 2788881234-canary-ts and restore dist-tag to 1.9.9
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback in progress for 2788881234-canary-ts. Removing 2.0.0 from 'canary'.
ops: Pinback applied for Dedicated fallback: redwood@1.4.14 pinned to 'fallback' pool (TTL 24h). API call done.
nora: I'll own release notes — will mark TS as delayed and add migration snippet. Draft PR when ready.
oliver: Rollback triggers recap: token error rate >2% sustained 10m, production canary smoke fail, checksum mismatch, auth regressions >1%. Ops to wire alerts (token-level error + latency).
ops: Alerts set. Playbook uploaded with quick npm dist-tag reassign and pinbackout steps.
sam: Proceeding with Py canary at 5% now. Monitor 30m then consider 25% ramp. TS waits for patch + quick canary.
oliver: Action owners: sam (deploy), tia (fix), ops (pins/alerts), nora (notes). Ping #eng-oncall if any triggers fire.
